messages.subject: Fixing item parameters
parts:
Hi Phil,

I would be interested in fixing some item parameters with the mirt.model function.

An example could follow the mirt manual


s <- 'F1 = 1,2,3,4-10
F2 = 10-20
(F1*F2) = 1,2,3,4-10
COV = F1*F2'
model <- mirt.model(s)

Now, I would want to fix the slopes of the first and second item and maybe the item intercepts of the items 1 to 5. How can I do this in mirt? Is it possible that the mean of F1 can then also be estimated?

Kind regards,
Alexander

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Fixing item parameters
parts:
Hi Alexander,

Great to hear from you again. Yes this is possible by editing the initial data.frame of parameter values. You can obtain this by passing the argument pars = 'values', edit this data.frame, and input it back into the function.

###
sv <- mirt(data, model, pars = 'values')
sv$est[fixedindex] <- FALSE
sv$value[valueindex] <- 1
mod <- mirt(data, model, pars = sv)
###

It's also possible to free the latent parameter this way as well. If you have a particular format that you are looking for, using sv <- edit(sv) is probably easiest way to edit the data.frame manually through the R GUI editor. Hope that helps.

Phil
